newsitem.title: USA: Babcock & Wilcox to supply PS Colorado.
newsitem.headline: Babcock & Wilcox to supply PS Colorado.

text.p: Babcock & Wilcox Power Generation Group said Thursday it has been awarded a $31 million contract by Public Service Co. of Colorado to supply environmental control equipment.
B&W, an operating unit of McDermott International Inc., will supply the equipment to the utility's coal-fired Hayden Generating Station units 1 and 2, in northwest Colorado.
The contract is part of an agreement between B&W, Black & Veatch Construction Inc. and the Public Service Company Generation Engineering Division.
Work at Hayden 1 is scheduled for completion in December 1998, B&W said. Unit 2 completion is scheduled for December 1999.
McDermott's stock rose $1.375 to $17.375 on the New York Stock Exchange in late trading.
